No extra scans, no spreadsheets, no sending crews out to count what the system already knows. Book a Demo Trusted by leaders in 3PL, warehousing, and logistics. Cycle Counts Are a Symptom , Not a Solution Most warehouses run cycle counts because they do not trust their inventory. But the cost of “fixing” bad data this way is huge: Crews pulled off real work to walk aisles and count. Overtime and weekend shifts spent reconciling numbers. Suspended operations while zones are frozen for counting. Arguments when the system says one thing and the floor says another. You pay twice : once in lost time and again in lost confidence. Cycle counts are a band-aid for inaccurate data. Forklift Vision fixes the data at the source. Track Every Pallet Move, As It Happens With Forklift Vision , cameras mounted on your forklifts read Zimark markers every time a pallet is picked up, put down, or moved. The pallet ID and new location are captured automatically. The move is time-stamped and stored. Your WMS is updated in real time, without operators doing anything extra. The result : your inventory reflects reality all day, every day. Counting becomes confirmation, not correction. Book a Demo See it in Action What Forklift Vision Unlocks Once You Stop Counting You are not just getting rid of a task. You are changing how the warehouse runs. Fewer planned shutdowns and less overtime Inventory stays accurate from Monday to Sunday, so there is less need for weekend counting marathons. Reliable inventory for sales and planning When your WMS matches reality, sales can promise stock with confidence and planning can forecast with better data. Smoother audits and simpler compliance Movement history, timestamps, and location data make audits faster and less stressful. Operators focused on moving product, not scanning Drivers keep doing what they do best. The cameras handle the tracking. Profit growing beyond fee revenue Cycle count charges cap out quickly, but higher throughput and better service let you move more pallets through the same fixed cost base and grow margins over time. jobs.description: Instant Proof of Load for Every Shipment | Zimark Skip to content Solutions Shipping Control Forklift Vision Benefits Eliminate Cycle Counts Instant Proof of Load Knowledge Center Solutions Shipping Control Forklift Vision Benefits Eliminate Cycle Counts Instant Proof of Load Knowledge Center Solutions Shipping Control Forklift Vision Benefits Eliminate Cycle Count Instant Proof of Load Knowledge Center Book a Call Book a Call Give The Best Customer Service With Instant Proof-of-Load Automatic recordings of every pallet loaded, ready to send to customers in one-click. Book a Demo Trusted by leaders in 3PL, warehousing, and logistics. 60 Bottles of Whisky Went Missing A bonded warehouse had loaded pallets of recently imported alcoholic beverages onto a truck for distribution to the customers. But when the delivery arrived, the CEO of the importer called the warehouse manager directly. The entire top row of a pallet was missing. Luckily, the warehouse had Zimark’s Shipping Control cameras at every dock door. The Warehouse Manager opened the app, searched for the shipment ID and sent video evidence of each pallet being loaded – fully complete. It took him less than 90 seconds. Book a Demo See it in Action They Increased Loading Speed by 20% A 3PL knew they needed proof of load. With no other option – they did it manually. Each time an operator loaded another layer into the truck – four pallets – they would stop. Get off the forklift. Take a photo on their phone. Get back on the forklift. And keep going. Then, the operator would have to upload all the photos via an app, before continuing to the next truck. One day the manager went to find a photo to send a customer. But deep in the truck, the photo he needed… was dark and barely visible. That’s when they decided to look for another solution. Something automatic, that would save time, save all the photos properly and make sure the pallets are identifiable. Book a Demo See it in Action Never Lose a Load Again Automatic, dock-door recordings for every single pallet — ready to share with customers in one click. Close claims in minutes, not days.
